description: 2022 - 2024 NTD Annual Data - Federal Funding Allocation is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. Dataset containing all of the Federal Funding Allocation inputs submitted by reporting transit agencies to the National Transit Database in the 2022 - 2024 report years. This reflects the most recently published data within the Federal Transit Administration's NTD Data website. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 41 columns, among them Year, Type Of Service, Mode Name, Mode, Reporter Type, NTD ID. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
